import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { relationTags } from "../../../backend/schema/relation_tags";

export const relationTagsCms = customizeTable<typeof relationTags>("relation_tags", {
    icon: "Tag",
    display: {
        title: "v"
    },
    fields: {
        v: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["relationId", "k", "version", "v"]
});
